android.desc: Type a calculation like a note and the answer appears instantly. No equals button. Write many calculations on one screen, mix text with math, and edit any line at any time. CalcNote is a notepad calculator that combines the ease of a calculator with the power of a spreadsheet. Example: comparing prices while shopping Shop A USD 18 * 2 items + USD 4 (shipping) Shop B USD 19 * 2 items (free shipping) + 8% (sales tax) Shop C USD 18.30 * 2 items + USD 5 (shipping) - USD 2 (points) Because notes and math live together, every calculation still makes sense when you read it later. Save your work as files, print it, or share it by email. [What you can do with CalcNote] - Compare prices and find the best deal while shopping - Track household expenses and plan a budget - Calculate sales tax, discounts, and percentages - Estimate travel costs within a limited budget - Use variables and line references like a spreadsheet (hourly wage = 15, daily wage = hourly wage * 8 ...) - Break a complex problem into simple steps and reuse previous results [A full calculator under the hood] From everyday math to business and engineering, CalcNote supports: - Percentage and tax (inclusive/exclusive) calculations - Unit converter (length, area, volume, mass, temperature, time, speed, fuel consumption, pressure, work) - Currency converter (156 currencies and 5 cryptocurrencies) - Scientific calculator functions - Trigonometry (degrees, radians, gradians) - Financial functions (compound interest, loans) - Aggregates (sum, average, variance, standard deviation) - User-defined functions in JavaScript - Logarithms (log10, log2) and natural logarithm - Permutations, combinations, factorial - Squares, powers, exponential functions, square and cube roots - Maximum, minimum, median - Rounding: round, floor, ceiling, bankers' rounding - Quotient and remainder of division - Hexadecimal, octal, binary, complements, and bitwise operations - Variables and reuse of previous results [Make it your own] - Change fonts and text size - Customize almost every color, or restyle the built-in themes - Arrange the keypad layout freely - Toggle key sounds and vibration - Set rounding methods, tax rate, precision, and decimal places - Define your own constants and functions - Reorder or hide menus - Adjust grammar such as decimal comma and comment symbols Disclaimer burton999 is committed to providing a high-quality, r
